note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alates, soldiers and workers are all described; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated; one of the two head-capsule indices of the soldier and one pronotal width measurement are omitted because of damaged OCR.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to yellowish brown, antennae uniformly yellow, mandibles blackish brown with dark brown base, body white to pale yellow. Pilosity of head sparse, body pilosity dense. Body length 5.0–7.4 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight or slightly convex, slightly narrowed in front of the antennae (head length to base of mandibles 1.75–2.15, maximum width 1.30–1.55, width at base of mandibles 1.20–1.45 mm; width at mandible base/maximum width index 0.71–0.79). Antennae 16-segmented, sometimes 17-segmented; in the 16-segmented condition segment 4 shortest, in the 17-segmented condition segment 3 shortest. Labrum subtriangular, apex slightly pointed. Mandibles strong, thick, sickle-shaped, incurved apically (length 1.08–1.23 mm), less than two-thirds the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.55–0.65). Left mandible with a large, pointed tooth at the middle, approximately at right angles to the mandibular axis (tooth distance 0.50–0.60 mm, tooth distance/mandible length index 0.44–0.50); right mandible with a rudimentary tooth at the middle. Postmentum long, subrectangular (length 1.15–1.43, maximum width 0.45–0.55 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, deeply concave at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margins (length 0.50–0.70 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellow, antennae and labrum paler, body and legs white to pale yellow; pilosity of head moderate, body pilosity dense. Body length 4.20–5.40 mm. Head capsule subcircular, widest at the antennal base (head length to base of mandibles 1.20–1.38, maximum width 1.45–1.60 mm). Antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus weakly inflated, pilose, length less than half the width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin distinctly upturned and deeply concave, posterior margin nearly straight, weakly concave at the middle (length 0.40–0.48, width 0.70–0.85 mm); mesonotum narrower and metanotum wider, the former with a weakly concave and the latter with an almost straight posterior margin. Minor worker: resembling the major worker but smaller; body length 3.0–4.0 mm, head length to base of mandibles 0.70–0.93, maximum width 0.85–1.10, pronotum length 0.33–0.40, maximum width 0.57–0.70 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown to chestnut brown, paler around the fontanelle, antennae, postclypeus and body yellowish brown, paler than the head capsule, pronotum with a paler T-shaped median mark, shoulder spots and two posterior median spots, wings brown. Pilosity of head and body fairly dense. Body length (including wings) 27.0–30.50 mm, without wings 12.0–15.20 mm. Head capsule subcircular (head length to base of mandibles 1.75–2.0, width including compound eyes 2.5–2.66 mm). Fontanelle minute, dot-like, slightly raised. Compound eyes medium-sized, subcircular (maximum diameter 0.60–0.70, minimum diameter 0.55–0.60 mm). Ocelli broadly oval (long diameter 0.23–0.30, short diameter 0.18–0.20 mm), separated from the compound eye by about the short diameter to slightly less than the long diameter (eye-ocellus distance 0.20–0.28 mm). Antennae 19-segmented; segment 2 slightly longer than half of segment 1, segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 subequal or slightly larger. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, length about equal to the width (length 0.50, width 1.0–1.10 mm, length/width index 0.45–0.50). Pronotum sub-trapezoidal, narrower than the head (length 1.35–1.50, width 2.33–2.58 mm), anterior margin slightly concave with a weak median emargination, posterior margin weakly convex, slightly concave at the middle. Wings brown (fore wing length 25.50 mm, hind wing length 24.0–24.6 mm); wing surface microstructure composed of fine, nearly straight or weakly curved obesus-type rods, the radial band separated from the radius at about the proximal third.
